resources.string: One fact about a country, city, mountain, river, landmark or award, from a Wikidata table, without the model.

• Population, area, capital, currency, official languages, continent and borders
• Height or elevation, length and depth
• When a landmark was built or came down
• Plug types and mains voltage
• Where an event was held, and an award's winner in a given year
• Two places compared: which is bigger, taller, longer or has more people
Does Brazil have more people than Russia?
What plug type and voltage does Brazil use?
If you stood the Burj Khalifa on the deepest point of Lake Baikal, would its top stick out of the water?

It answers only when the question names something in the table and asks for exactly one of these; every answer ends with its source and the table\'s date (Wikidata, CC0, October 2026), and an older population figure says how old it is. Two properties at once, an overview, a why or how question, a name it can\'t tell apart (Georgia), or a chat about health goes to the model as usual. Questions in English only. Ported from r4to\'s offline facts (BOAR R&D).
